challengeTypes: identify: What is an ADAPTATION? (A body feature or behaviour that helps an animal survive in its environment vs A type of food animals eat vs A place where animals live)
identify: Which adaptation helps a CAMEL survive in the hot desert? (Stores water in its hump and has thick padded feet for hot sand vs Has thick fur for cold vs Has gills to breathe underwater)
sort: Drag each animal to its correct habitat (Desert: camel, desert fox | Water: fish, duck, frog | Cold mountain: polar bear, yak | Forest: lion, elephant, monkey)
identify: A fish has fins and a streamlined body. What is this an adaptation for? (Swimming easily in water vs Running fast on land vs Flying in the air)
sort: Drag each animal to its food habit group (Herbivores: cow, deer, elephant, goat | Carnivores: lion, tiger, eagle, snake | Omnivores: bear, human, crow, dog)
identify: Why do desert plants like cactus have SPINES instead of broad leaves? (To reduce water loss and protect from animals vs To catch more sunlight vs To attract insects)

sort: Drag each plant to its correct habitat adaptation (Water: lotus has broad floating leaves, hollow stem | Desert: cactus has spines, thick stem to store water | Hilly: pine has needle-like leaves to shed snow | Land: mango has broad leaves, deep roots)

sort: Drag each adaptation to its correct purpose (Thick fur: keep warm in cold | Webbed feet: swim in water | Sharp claws: catch prey | Long legs: run fast on plains | Spines on cactus: reduce water loss | Needle leaves: shed snow)
extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Animal adaptation concept — adaptation is a change in body structure or behaviour that helps an animal survive in its environment. Habitat is the place where an animal lives. Adaptations help animals find food, escape predators, cope with climate, and reproduce. (2) Animal adaptations by habitat — desert: camel stores water in hump, thick padded feet for hot sand, light colour. Water: fish has fins and streamlined body for swimming, gills to breathe. Cold mountain: polar bear has thick fur and fat layer for warmth, yak has long hair. Forest: lion has sharp teeth and claws for hunting, monkey has long tail for climbing. (3) Adaptation by food habits — herbivores (plant eaters): cow, deer, elephant, goat — flat teeth for grinding, broad hooves. Carnivores (meat eaters): lion, tiger, eagle — sharp teeth for tearing, sharp claws for catching prey. Omnivores (eat both): bear, human, crow, dog. (4) Plant adaptation concept — plants also adapt to their habitats. (5) Plant adaptations by habitat — water: lotus has broad floating leaves and hollow stem for buoyancy. Desert: cactus has spines instead of leaves (reduces water loss), thick fleshy stem stores water, deep roots. Hilly/cold: pine has needle-like leaves to shed snow, cone shape prevents snow accumulation. Land: mango has broad leaves for sunlight, deep tap roots for water. Root types: tap root (one main root with branches — carrot, mustard, radish) and fibrous root (many thin roots of same size — grass, maize, wheat). Misconceptions: 'all animals in the same habitat look the same' (animals in the same habitat can have different adaptations based on their food habits), 'cactus spines are leaves that got smaller' (spines are MODIFIED leaves that reduce water loss and protect from animals), 'only animals adapt' (plants also adapt — cactus stores water, lotus has hollow stem, pine has needle leaves), 'camels store water in their hump' (the hump stores FAT which can be converted to water and energy, not liquid water). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function AdaptationsGame), NOT export default. Export interface AdaptationsGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
